G37 (priority areas — adaptation gap used in prioritisation), G33 (vulnerability — IND09 inverted), IND09 (adaptation coverage), IND10 (adaptation gap)

Adaptation inventory is a positive asset — it shows what communities already have in place. High adaptation = lower vulnerability (IND09 protective direction). The adaptation gap (IND10) is the complementary measure — residual risk after existing adaptation is accounted for. Both must be computed before G37 Priority Areas. Household adaptation data from DB02 must be aggregated to community level — no individual household adaptation records in G36.
